name: Stream Finance / xUSD collapse and the November 2025 curator crisis

window_utc.note: Root loss occurred 2025-10-10 off-chain and was concealed ~3 weeks. Public window: Balancer exploit + freeze eve (Nov 3) through USDX capitulation (~Nov 14). Workout/liquidation still ongoing as of 2026-08-22 — xUSD never repegged.

speed: Hours-to-days for the crash leg: freeze + disclosure (late Nov 3 US / early Nov 4 UTC) → xUSD ~$0.50 in ~12h → $0.23-0.30 within 24h; deUSD -98% in ~48h; USDX broke 48h later. Months-to-years for the workout leg (liquidation entity formed Mar 2026; no distributions as of Aug 2026). Root loss preceded public phase by ~3 weeks (concealment).
summary: Кризис кураторов ноября 2025: Stream Finance раскрыла потерю ~$93M внешним управляющим (убыток случился 10.10 и ~3 недели скрывался), ЗАМОРОЗИЛА вводы/выводы — и лишь ПОТОМ xUSD рухнул до $0.23-0.30 (выйти было нельзя ни по какой цене). deUSD Элixir (65% обеспечения — займы Stream) −98%, USDX < $0.60. ~$285M экспозиции через КУРАТОРНЫЕ рынки Morpho/Euler (TelosC $123.6M, Elixir $68M, MEV Capital $25.4M), захардкоженные $1-оракулы блокировали ликвидации. ~$1B недельного оттока из yield-стейблов — крупнейший с Luna. USDC/USDT пеги целы; Steakhouse USDC исторически НЕ пострадал — но канал куратора это ровно наш morpho-рукав, один куратор в сторону. Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: ETH flash-crash/liquidation cascade. Stream Finance's external fund manager (trader Ryan DeMattia per the Dec 2025 lawsuit) loses ~$93M (~17.5% of AUM) in off-chain 'delta-neutral' strategies. Loss is not disclosed for ~3 weeks.

Analyst CBB publishes on-chain warning: only ~$170M collateral supports xUSD on-chain vs ~$530M borrowed from lending protocols (~4.1x effective leverage via recursive looped minting). Yearn dev Schlagonia had privately warned Stream ~172 days earlier (per rekt.news).

Balancer v2 exploited for $116M initial estimate / $128.6M final (rounding-error in batchSwap invariant math) across 6 chains — DeFi-wide risk-off the same week, initially (wrongly) blamed for Stream's hole.

Hardcoded-oracle failure: many curated markets on Morpho/Euler/Silo priced xUSD collateral at a fixed $1.00 (MEV Capital's market: hardcoded $1.26 exchange rate) while spot fell to ~$0.23 — liquidations never fired; utilization hit 100%, borrow APRs spiked to ~88%; lenders could not withdraw.

Researcher collective YAM (Yields & More) maps $284.96M of Stream-linked debt across ≥7 networks and curated vaults: TelosC $123.64M (Euler, largely Plasma), Elixir $68M (private Morpho markets), MEV Capital $25.42M (Morpho/Euler), Varlamore $19.17M (Silo), Re7 Labs $14.65M, Enclabs $2.56M, Mithras $2.3M, plus TiD/Invariant Group and others — 'not an extensive list'.

FREEZE BEFORE DEEP DEPEG: Stream announces on X (late Nov 3 US evening / early hours Nov 4 UTC; exact minute not published) that the external manager lost ~$93M, and suspends ALL deposits and withdrawals effective immediately; retains Perkins Coie. Primary redemption closes while xUSD still trades near peg — secondary DEX pools become the only exit.

xUSD crashes AFTER the freeze: ~-25% then through $0.50 within ~12h of the announcement (PeckShield), reaching $0.23–$0.30 within 24h (-70..77%). ~$160M of user deposits frozen; Stream TVL had peaked >$200M.
Elixir deUSD breaks: ~65% of its backing (~$68M USDC) had been lent to Stream via private permissioned Morpho markets; deUSD collapses ~98% to ~$0.015 on secondary markets.

Elixir announces full wind-down of deUSD/sdeUSD; ~80% of non-Stream holders redeem 1:1 in USDC before/through the wind-down; snapshot + claims portal for the remainder; Elixir asserts intent to make non-Stream holders 100% whole (its claim against Stream disputed).

Stables Labs USDX (similar opaque delta-neutral model, peak supply reported ~$685M) depegs below $0.60, printing ~$0.30 lows; PancakeSwap and Lista DAO 'monitoring'; USDX slides to ~$0.04 by Nov 14. Re7 reports >$13M stuck in Stables-Labs-linked markets with no response from the issuer.

Euler emerges as the single largest lender to Stream: ~$137M of Stream-linked bad debt attributed to Euler curated markets (TelosC, Re7, K3, MEV Capital vaults; Euler DAO's own core markets reported zero exposure). Figure is a secondary-source consensus, mostly unrealized claims vs the Stream estate rather than instantly socialized depositor loss.

Sector-wide run on the curator model: ~$1B leaves yield-bearing stablecoins in one week (Stablewatch; largest weekly outflow since Luna 2022), hitting even unaffected issuers (Reservoir, YieldFi, Coinshift TVL down sharply, pegs held). Morpho co-founder Paul Frambot: only '1 out of ~320 vaults on the Morpho App' had xUSD exposure — isolation worked, but vault due-diligence burden lands on depositors.

MORPHO-CURATOR LOSS CRYSTALLIZED: MEV Capital removes the Elixir sdeUSD/USDC market from its Ethereum Morpho USDC vault, REALIZING bad debt equal to ~3.6% of vault TVL (on top of ~$650k xUSD bad debt where its oracle was hardcoded at $1.26 vs $0.23 spot). Re7 Labs discloses ~$27.4M total bad debt across xUSD/USDT0 (Euler Plasma) and deUSD/sdeUSD (Morpho) markets. Steakhouse Financial (Nov 4 statement) and Gauntlet had zero exposure to xUSD/yUSD/deUSD/mHYPER/mMEV.

Stream Trading Corp. sues current owner-operator Caleb '0xlaw' McMeans (N.D. Cal.), alleging he ran Stream 'as his own business', hired the trader who lost ~$93M, and moved ~$2.1M through Railgun to personal wallets two days before disclosure (later returned). Perkins Coie-led investigation produced no public report.

Stream breaks ~6-month silence: wind-down via 'Stream Soft Holding Company' (Delaware, incorporated 2026-03-20), an Assignment-for-Benefit-of-Creditors-style liquidation to consolidate and distribute remaining assets; begins collecting creditor claims toward a 'potential global resolution' — no recovery %, no deadline, no distribution yet.

SiloDAO files a consolidated recovery claim with Stream on behalf of affected lenders: >$31.6M in stablecoin claims plus 272.70 BTC. As of 2026-08-22 no distributions or haircut percentages have been announced; xUSD trades as a distressed claim (~$0.07–$0.17 range reported through late 2025 / 2026).

defi_impact.morpho: Elixir's $68M to Stream sat in private/permissioned Morpho markets (largest single Morpho-channel chunk). Public curated vaults: MEV Capital Ethereum Morpho USDC vault realized bad debt ≈3.6% of vault TVL (sdeUSD/USDC removal, 2025-11-12) plus ~$650k xUSD bad debt; Re7 deUSD/sdeUSD Morpho markets hit. Morpho isolation held: ~1 of ~320 Morpho App vaults exposed (Frambot); protocol itself solvent, no MORPHO governance bailout.
defi_impact.euler: Largest lender to Stream: ~$137M Stream-linked bad debt in curated markets (TelosC's $123.64M concentrated largely in Plasma xUSD markets; Re7, K3, MEV Capital also exposed); Euler DAO core markets reported zero exposure; recovery depends on Stream estate — unresolved as of 2026-08-22.
defi_impact.silo: Varlamore-curated markets ~$19.17M exposure; SiloDAO later filed consolidated claim >$31.6M stables + 272.70 BTC (Jul 2026).
defi_impact.elixir: deUSD wound down entirely; ~80% of holders redeemed 1:1 USDC, remainder via claims portal; deUSD market price -98% during the run.
defi_impact.stables_labs_usdx: USDX depegged Nov 6 (<$0.60, then ~$0.30, ~$0.04 by Nov 14); Re7 reported >$13M stuck; issuer unresponsive.
defi_impact.curators: Re7 Labs ~$27.4M total bad debt; MEV Capital $25.42M exposure; TelosC $123.64M; smaller: Enclabs $2.56M, Mithras $2.3M, TiD/Invariant Group. Unaffected by choice: Steakhouse Financial (explicit zero exposure to xUSD/yUSD/deUSD/mHYPER/mMEV) and Gauntlet.
defi_impact.sector: ~$1B weekly outflow from yield-bearing stablecoins (largest since Luna); curator-model trust crisis — calls for curator disclosure standards, oracle policy (no hardcoded pegs for redeemable-only assets), and proof-of-reserve for 'delta-neutral' stables; Aave camp used it to argue against externalized risk management.
defi_impact.aave_pendle_maple: Aave v3 core markets: no xUSD/deUSD/USDX listings, no bad debt — beneficiary of flight to quality. Maple: no reported Stream exposure. Pendle: pools existed for affected synthetic-dollar ecosystems (e.g. sUSDX); PTs on such underlyings became claims on broken collateral, while blue-chip PT markets functioned.

causes.root_cause: Off-chain, unverifiable asset management: one external trader (Ryan DeMattia per lawsuit) controlled Stream user funds without multisig/custody controls and lost ~$93M (~17.5% of AUM) around the 2025-10-10 ETH crash; loss concealed ~3 weeks before the 2025-11-04 disclosure-plus-freeze.
causes.amplifier_1_recursive_leverage: Looped/recursive minting: ~$170M real on-chain collateral supporting ~$530M of borrowings (~4.1x) across Euler/Morpho/Silo — xUSD supply inflated far beyond backing (publicly flagged by CBB on 2025-10-28, by Schlagonia ~172 days earlier).
causes.amplifier_2_hardcoded_oracles: Curated lending markets priced xUSD at a FIXED $1.00 (MEV Capital market: fixed $1.26 exchange rate) 'to avoid depeg liquidation cascades' — when spot hit $0.23 liquidations never fired; borrowers kept real USDC, lenders held mispriced collateral; utilization hit 100% with ~88% borrow APR, freezing lender exits.
causes.amplifier_3_curator_agency_problem: Third-party curators (TelosC, MEV Capital, Re7, Varlamore, K3 …) chasing fee/TVL growth allocated depositor USDC into exotic Stream/Elixir collateral markets on Morpho/Euler/Silo; depositors saw 'Morpho/Euler' branding, not the curator's risk book.
causes.amplifier_4_rehypothecation_web: Elixir lent 65% of deUSD backing (~$68M) to Stream via private Morpho markets; USDX ran similar opaque strategies — one desk's loss propagated into three stablecoins and $285M of interlinked debt across ≥7 chains.
causes.trigger_context: Balancer v2 exploit ($116–128.6M) on 2025-11-03 put DeFi risk-off the same week; freeze-then-disclosure forced all xUSD exit through thin DEX pools.
causes.freeze_vs_depeg_ordering: Freeze came FIRST: withdrawals/deposits suspended with the disclosure (late Nov 3 US / early Nov 4 UTC) while xUSD was still near peg; the -77% crash unfolded over the following 12–24h on secondary markets.

contagion: Curated-vault channel: USDC depositors in Morpho/Euler/Silo vaults → curator allocations into xUSD/deUSD collateral markets → bad debt socialized to vault depositors (MEV Capital -3.6% realized; Re7 ~$27.4M; TelosC $123.64M claims)
Stablecoin backing channel: Elixir deUSD (65% of backing lent to Stream) → -98% and wind-down; Stables Labs USDX (similar strategy) → -95%+
Oracle channel: hardcoded $1.00/$1.26 xUSD prices → no liquidations → 100% utilization → lender withdrawals frozen across chains (Ethereum, Plasma, Sonic, Worldchain, +)
Confidence channel: ~$1B one-week outflow from yield-bearing stablecoins including untouched issuers; curated-vault TVL contraction and borrow-rate spikes sector-wide
Same-week compounding: Balancer v2 exploit ($116-128.6M, Nov 3) primed risk-off and was initially misattributed as Stream's cause
Workout channel (slow): Stream estate claims (Elixir $68M, Euler curators ~$137M, SiloDAO $31.6M+272.7 BTC) unresolved into Aug 2026 — recovery uncertainty kept xUSD at deep discount

recovery.xusd_peg: Never recovered — trades as a distressed claim ($0.165 mid-Nov 2025; $0.07-0.14 later; no repeg as of 2026-08-22)
recovery.stream_estate: Perkins Coie investigation (no public findings) → Stream Trading Corp. v. McMeans lawsuit (2025-12-08, N.D. Cal.) → Stream Soft Holding Company (Delaware, 2026-03-20) running an ABC-style wind-down announced May 2026; creditor claims being collected toward 'global resolution'; NO distribution, recovery rate, or haircut % announced as of 2026-08-22
recovery.elixir_deusd: Best outcome of the three: ~80% of holders redeemed 1:1 in USDC; remainder via snapshot/claims portal; Elixir's $68M claim vs Stream disputed on priority
recovery.curated_vaults: MEV Capital Morpho USDC vault: -3.6% realized haircut, exposure removed, vault continued; Re7 ~$27.4M bad debt with legal recovery pending; Euler ~$137M and Silo claims ($31.6M + 272.70 BTC filed Jul 2026) pending against the estate
recovery.curator_model_aftermath: Structural repricing, not extinction: ~$1B sector outflow, TVL migration to conservative curators (Steakhouse, Gauntlet), push for curator disclosure/oracle standards; Morpho defended isolation design ('1 of ~320 vaults'); institutional curated vaults kept launching into 2026 (e.g. Bitwise on Morpho)

confidence_notes: High confidence (2+ independent sources): $93M loss; Nov 4 (UTC) disclosure-plus-freeze preceding the deep depeg; xUSD -70..77% within 24h with floor in $0.23-0.30; $285M ($284.96M) YAM exposure map and its top lines (TelosC $123.64M, Elixir $68M/65% of backing, MEV Capital $25.42M, Varlamore $19.17M); hardcoded $1 oracles blocking liquidations; deUSD -98% and wind-down with ~80% 1:1 redemptions; USDX <$0.60 Nov 6; Balancer v2 $116-128.6M Nov 3; MEV Capital Morpho vault -3.6% realized (primary statement); Re7 ~$27.4M (primary report); Dec 8 lawsuit and 2026 wind-down (court/liquidator coverage). Medium confidence: Euler ~$137M bad debt (multiple secondary outlets, likely one analytic origin; largely claims vs estate, not final realized loss); ~$1B weekly yield-stable outflow (Stablewatch via secondary reports); USDX peak supply ~$685M (single source); '172 days' Schlagonia warning (rekt.news only); $160M frozen deposits (widely repeated, single analytic origin). Approximate timestamps: intraday times are date-level except where sourced; the 04:00 UTC disclosure time is an estimate from 'early hours Nov 4 UTC / Nov 3 evening US' reporting — flagged, not fabricated. xUSD from-price ambiguity: media used $1.00 peg reference while the token's oracle exchange rate was $1.26 (yield-accruing), so drawdown is -77% vs $1.00 or ~-80% vs $1.26. Direct fetches of several primary URLs (rekt.news, The Block, CoinDesk, protos, CoinGecko) were blocked by this environment's egress proxy; their content was verified via search-index extraction of those same articles — URLs listed are the canonical sources.

spa_relevance.book: $100k USDC: Aave v3 40% / Pendle PT 20% / Maple 15% / Morpho Steakhouse USDC 15% / cash 10%
spa_relevance.aave_v3_40pct: Near-zero direct loss in the historical event (no exotic synthetic-dollar collateral on Aave core). Stress residual: deposit-rate compression + short utilization spikes as refugees rotate in/out. Historical-analog loss: ~$0 of $40k.
spa_relevance.pendle_pt_20pct: CONDITIONAL on underlying. PT on a blue-chip underlying: par at maturity, temporary secondary-market discount/illiquidity (mark-to-market -2..-10% intraweek plausible). PT on a curated synthetic-dollar (sUSDX/deUSD-class): principal loss up to -70..-98% — the Nov 2025 lesson is that PT 'fixed yield' is only as good as the redeemability of the underlying. Historical-analog loss for a quality-screened PT book: ~$0-1k of $20k.
spa_relevance.maple_15pct: No direct Nov-2025 exposure; Maple gained share afterward. But structural rhyme is direct: off-chain credit/underwriting with delayed loss disclosure is exactly Stream's failure mode — model a freeze-then-haircut path (weeks of gated withdrawals) rather than a smooth drawdown. Historical-analog loss: $0 of $15k.
spa_relevance.morpho_steakhouse_15pct: THE CHANNEL OF THIS EVENT — curated Morpho USDC vault. Actual Steakhouse vaults: ZERO exposure (explicit 2025-11-04 statement; blue-chip collateral only) → historical loss $0. Counterfactual with an MEV-Capital-grade curator: realized -3.6% of TVL (≈ -$540 on $15k) PLUS days-to-weeks of 100% utilization (withdrawals effectively frozen, borrow APR ~88%); worst curated books (Re7/TelosC-style xUSD concentration) ran to double-digit % unresolved claims. Stress-test both legs: small haircut AND illiquidity window; monitor curator allocations weekly — exotic collateral appearing in the vault is the leading indicator (CBB's warning gave 6 days; Schlagonia's ~6 months).
spa_relevance.cash_10pct: USDC itself unaffected. Cash is the rebalancing ammunition during the 1-2 week illiquidity window.
spa_relevance.estimated_book_impact: Historical replay: ≈$0 direct loss (Steakhouse/Aave/Maple clean) + mark-to-market noise on Pendle PT. Adverse-curator counterfactual: -0.5% to -2% NAV ($500-$2,000), dominated by the Morpho vault sleeve, plus 1-3 weeks of partial illiquidity on 15-35% of book. Kill-switch note: SOFT -5% would NOT trip on the historical replay; an xUSD-grade curated allocation (10-15% of a vault at -77%) would.
spa_relevance.key_lesson_for_spa: Freeze precedes depeg: by the time the price signal exists, the exit is closed. Gates must key on disclosure/withdrawal-halt events and curator-allocation changes, not on price alone — consistent with SPA's fail-CLOSED/refusal-first design and the ADR-053 live-TVL-only rule (a hardcoded $1 oracle is exactly a 'stamped literal').

assumptions: Steakhouse USDC в историческом событии НЕ пострадал (экспонированы были MEV Capital/Re7/TelosC) — потерь morpho-рукава нет; заморозка выхода 1-3 дня — оценка утилизационного пика панической недели, не замер.
Контрфакт «наш куратор оказался экспонирован» живёт в SYN_S03 (morpho −12% + заморозка), сюда намеренно не вписан.
